children: Integrated Biopharma Inc reported fiscal 2026 results with revenue of $43.87M, down from $54.35M a year earlier, producing a net loss of ($2.84M) and diluted EPS of ($0.09) — a year-over-year decline versus FY 2025 — according to its 10-K filing.
¹ Reported as “Sales, net”. ² Reported as “Net (loss) income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per common share”.

Revenue decline of 19.3% was driven by lower demand from major contract manufacturing customers; two contract manufacturing customers represented roughly 90% of sales, underscoring customer concentration risk.
Gross margin compressed sharply to about 1.8% as fixed manufacturing costs remained largely unchanged despite lower volumes.
Selling expenses were modestly lower, with reduced commissions and workforce reductions offset in part by higher benefits.
Capital spending totaled $346K in FY26, with roughly $500K budgeted for FY27 to support production capacity and operations.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
